mapper.select: SELECT dept_id FROM hr_employee WHERE id = #{employeeId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.sql: FROM hr_schedule_assignment assignment LEFT JOIN hr_attendance_rule rule ON rule.id = assignment.rule_id AND rule.tenant_id = assignment.tenant_id JOIN hr_employee employee ON employee.id = #{employeeId} AND employee.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee.deleted = 0 WHERE assignment.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ((assignment.target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' AND assignment.target_id = employee.id) OR (assignment.target_type = 'DEPT' AND assignment.target_id = employee.dept_id)) AND (assignment.schedule_date = #{date} OR (assignment.schedule_date IS NULL AND assignment.effective_start <= #{date} AND (assignment.effective_end IS NULL OR assignment.effective_end >= #{date}))) AND assignment.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PUBLISHED') ORDER BY CASE WHEN assignment.target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN assignment.schedule_date IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, assignment.effective_start DESC, assignment.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT assignment.schedule_date, assignment.effective_start, assignment.effective_end, COALESCE(assignment.shift_id, rule.shift_id) AS shift_id, shift.holiday_calendar_id AS calendar_id FROM hr_employee employee JOIN hr_schedule_assignment assignment ON assignment.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ((assignment.target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' AND assignment.target_id = employee.id) OR (assignment.target_type = 'DEPT' AND assignment.target_id = employee.dept_id)) LEFT JOIN hr_attendance_rule rule ON rule.id = assignment.rule_id AND rule.tenant_id = assignment.tenant_id LEFT JOIN hr_shift shift ON shift.id = COALESCE(assignment.shift_id, rule.shift_id) AND shift.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE employee.id = #{employeeId} AND employee.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee.deleted = 0 AND assignment.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PUBLISHED') AND (assignment.schedule_date BETWEEN #{firstDate} AND #{lastDate} OR (assignment.schedule_date IS NULL AND assignment.effective_start <= #{lastDate} AND (assignment.effective_end IS NULL OR assignment.effective_end >= #{firstDate}))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN assignment.target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN assignment.schedule_date IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, assignment.effective_start DESC, assignment.id DESC
